phase.coreElapsedNanos: native metadata traversal, analysis, callbacks, projection and result drop; excludes oracle, result verification and signature export

phase.real: whole process; not an interactive CLI/TUI measurement

order: legacy/completion in repetitions 1 and 3, completion/legacy in repetition 2; separate equivalence calls outside repetitions
equivalenceContract: ordinary walk/stat and full content hash oracle; callback facts keep native identities, locators, fingerprint, coverage and evidence; scan/entry identities and observation times normalized after native binding validation; duplicate live stamps compared
limitations: three repetitions per mode and workload; no p95/p99 inference
single macOS host and debug build; no release or target-host performance claim
duplicate latency ranges overlap; no stable duplicate speedup claim
scanner/collector metadata and cache-preview persistence retain existing budgets; not a global RSS bound
legacy export remains materialized; Linux durable journal still required
no concurrent fixture mutation, symlinks, hard-link aliases or real provider in benchmark
